proposed_capability: An explicitly invoked bounded asynchronous host session monitors needs while a host-owned gardening interaction awaits its outcome; arbitrate one Sim action, safe preemption and fresh revalidation before resumption.
player_save_control_impact: Async callback ports, no implicit activation, background thread/daemon, game hook, saves, building or input implementation. Existing listener tick/presence and independent screen_admit remain required. Cancelling a Python callback never authorizes cancelling a Sim queue.
expected_outcome: Real coroutine observation continues while execution awaits; an observed sleep remedy can interrupt only a freshly ownership-bound host gardening action; gardening resumes from a new capture after needs recover. Player, actor identity, unknown ownership, stale evidence and ACK-only outcomes fail closed.
negative_tests: Needs observer advances while gardening execution is pending
Host-owned gardening preempted for sleep, then resumes from new observation
Unknown ownership or changed actor never cancels game action
Fresh player input yields without queue cancellation
ACK or timeout is not an observed outcome and never replays action
Bounded tick count and observer/action timeouts; no leaked tasks
rollback_path: Revert isolated source commits; no game files, placements or saves touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Current live needs/responsibilities and plant interactions require fresh observation
No live gardening benefit or hunger certification claimed
